blocks.html: Whether you’re an avid hiker exploring new trails or simply looking to bring a bit of Nordic calm to your daily life, we invite you to embrace the essence of vandra and discover your own path forward.

Born in the heart of Scandinavia, our ethos is shaped by the region’s long-standing traditions of enjoying nature in all its forms—like Norway’s “tura” culture of everyday adventures, Finland’s spirit of overcoming the rugged outdoors, and Sweden’s love for camping and fishing in pristine forests and lakes. These customs have taught us that stepping outside, even for a short wander, can bring clarity, joy, and a sense of connection to the world around us.
Discover more about us →

blocks.html: Frequently asked questions.

Here, you’ll find clear answers to the most common questions about our baby carriers—whether you’re new to our products or simply looking for more details. If you still have questions after reading, feel free to contact our support team.
Contact us →

items.q: Which age group can use these baby carriers?
items.a: Our baby carriers are designed for children who can sit upright unassisted, typically around 6 months old. The carrier supports weights from 16 lbs to 40 lbs (7.3 kg to 18.1 kg), depending on your child’s size and activity level.

items.q: Are the straps easy to adjust?
items.a: Yes. Each carrier has multiple points of adjustment, so you can quickly fine-tune the fit for both you and your child. This makes it simple to switch between different wearers.
We use a blend of lightweight, breathable fabrics for the main body, along with sturdy, padded straps for support. This combination helps ensure comfort and durability.

items.q: How do I clean the baby carrier?
items.a: Cleaning is simple — hand-wash the fabric with lukewarm water and pH-neutral soap. For full care instructions, please refer to the Owner’s Manual included with your carrier.

items.q: Does the design differ for the Glacier, Forest, and River models?
items.a: The features are consistent across all three carriers, but each one comes in a unique color scheme—off-white and grey for Glacier, deep green for Forest, and soothing blue for River—so you can pick the style that resonates with you.

items.q: Do they comply with safety standards?
items.a: Yes. The carriers are tested and certified by TÜV to meet ASTM F2549 standards for frame child carriers. All materials and construction methods comply with applicable U.S. safety regulations.
